name: feature_scan
description: Sweep a whole image or blob with bulk_extractor and say what it wrote: every output file with its kind (feature file, histogram, run report, alerts, pcap, other), and for each feature file its line count, distinct values (a lower bound past 200,000) and the offset of the first. No feature value is returned in the answer, but the files bulk_extractor writes in out_dir are unfiltered and hold them (feature files, histogram files and alerts.txt, which can carry a whole recovery key): out_dir is made 0700 and its files 0600 when the child ends, the answer says out_dir_contains_secret_values and kinds_holding_values, and the job runs with secret_output: true; write_values: true (in a job only) also writes each feature file's most frequent values to a 0600 file under $OUT. Histogram files are counted apart from feature files. The exit code, stdout and stderr are returned and kept in files: a nonzero exit is status partial or failed, never clean, and complete means bulk_extractor exited 0, not that every scanner reached every byte. Works with no file system at all: the offset is the provenance, there is no path. The manifest makes every job of this tool secret output (out_dir holds the values), and write_values is refused in a job whose process lacks SECRET_OUTPUT=1. bulk_extractor runs through the shared process block (its own process group, ended with what it started at the deadline and on SIGTERM, SIGINT or SIGHUP, which give one JSON answer, partial and interrupted, with the modes of what it wrote restricted); a program that cannot be started is a JSON failure. Counting what it wrote is on a clock that ends at 1,150 seconds, below this tool's 1,200: what the clock cut short is named in not_counted and the status is partial. PROGRAM LEFTOVERS: a bulk_extractor that exits and leaves a process running (in the tool's group, in a session of its own, or holding none of the tool's descriptors) is ended by the shared process block before out_dir is walked and counted, and the answer is partial with program_group.left_behind and a problem line; where the block cannot show that none was left (a host that is not Linux, or PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER refused) the answer is at most partial (program_group.unproven), because the files it wrote cannot be shown to be final. The exit code follows the status.

path.description: An image, a partition, or any blob

out_dir.description: Where the feature files land: a directory under work/ (in a job, under $OUT, the one place a job writes). It must not already hold files.

only.description: Run only these scanners, e.g. ["email","exif"]; the installed bulk_extractor says which exist

top.description: With write_values: how many distinct values per feature file are written (default 15)

write_values.description: Write each feature file's top values to a 0600 file under $OUT. Refused outside a job. Every job of this tool is run as secret output. Default false.

timeout_seconds.description: Give up after this long (default 900, from 10 to 1000); what was written is then listed as partial
